sources.quality_notes: Official NII union catalog lists Tokyo University General Library as one holding, call no. G23:194, work-volume52 individual no. 0008542011, 81 physical books 28-29cm; 朝鮮刊本, 9行17字, 双魚尾, 包背装, later marginalia and replacement leaves. Waseda ri06_02809 is separately held as 80 books 31cm with unknown imprint. Different book counts and catalog marks are NOT a proof of same/different original plate, physical impression or independent printed numeric witness. Exact UTokyo firstparty OPAC openURL was HTTP403 from tested web environment, not physical absence. No work52 image, D16/D18 original glyph, crop SHA or cumulative numeric vote.
